description: This file defines an Angular component 'NotesPageComponent' which manages a notes-taking application's main notes page. It handles displaying a list of notes, selecting, creating, editing, and deleting notes via interacting with a notes storage service, and manages routing and UI states.

classes.name: NotesPageComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for managing a notes interface, including listing, selecting, creating, editing, and deleting notes, with routing and UI state management.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component by subscribing to the notes list and route parameters to keep UI state synchronized with the data and URL.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Unsubscribes from observable subscriptions to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Prepares the editor for creating a new note by resetting the model and opening the editor.

methods.name: onSelect
methods.description: Navigates to a specific note by ID.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the edited or new note through the storage service, then updates UI and routing.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Loads the selected note into the editor for editing.

methods.name: onRequestDelete
methods.description: Opens a confirmation dialog for deleting the selected note.

methods.name: onConfirmDelete
methods.description: Deletes the selected note upon confirmation, and updates the view and routing.

methods.name: onCancelDelete
methods.description: Closes the delete confirmation dialog without deleting.

methods.name: activeNote
methods.description: Getter that returns the currently selected note object or null if none selected.
